messages:
pagerbot: 🔔 PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-8492 - inference-serving-eu - 5xx spike on /v1/generate -> auto-page to #incidents. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-INC-8492
Sam: ack — I'm on it. pulling logs now.
Priya: acknowledged. if you need a hand I can take playbook steps 3-5.
Sam: seeing 5xx rate ~12% from seq-router -> embeddings queue backpressure? quick grep:
```
kubectl logs seq-router-12 -n prod | grep "upstream error" | tail -n 20
```
getting stack traces showing redis timeout ~ReadTimeoutError
Jorge: @Sam any recent deploys to seq-router in last 15m? I can check canary.
Sam: none from me. deploy-bot shows no rollouts. looks like redis timeouts spike at 12:14:20 UTC.
pagerbot: :eyes: reaction from Priya
Priya: I'm taking over — Sam needs to step off for 30m. Priya -> taking ownership. running failovers: set replica_count=3 for seq-router and bump redis conn pool. executing now:
```
kubectl scale deploy/seq-router -n prod --replicas=3
# then bump redis pool config via ssm/params
```
Sam: SGTM, handing off to @Priya. leaving bridge for now. tagging incident: customer-impact:high
Priya: 12:20 UTC: scaled seq-router to 3, connection pool increased. 5xx dropped to ~4% -> still above baseline. continuing mitigation.
Jorge: I'll monitor infra metrics; if latency continues will route traffic to fallback model variant.
Priya: performing a controlled rollback/route to model-variant-2 for EU traffic (canary -> 100% for shard-1):
```
# redwoodctl snippet
redwoodctl rollout set --route /v1/generate --region eu --model variant-2 --weight 100
```
Priya: 12:27 UTC: rollout complete. 5xx now ~0.5%, errors near normal. customer impact window: 12:13–12:26 UTC; estimated affected requests ~3.2k (~0.15% of daily EU traffic). notifying support and preparing summary.
Sam: thanks @Priya and @Jorge. handing back to infra oncall for postmortem. I'll update PD ticket with logs and timeline.
pagerbot: ✅ PagerDuty PD-INC-8492 acknowledged by Priya. Escalation suppressed; please close in PagerDuty once postmortem is attached.
Priya: I'll close after writing the postmortem. quick notes for ticket: suspected root cause = transient redis connection storm (network flaps) leading to client timeouts -> seq-router error cascade. Mitigations applied: scaled seq-router, increased redis pool, routed to variant-2. Action items: 1) tune redis client pool; 2) add circuit breaker & backpressure in seq-router; 3) add alert suppression for known transient blips and refine SLO noise threshold.
Sam: added tag 'needs-investigation' and assigned to eng-sre. cc @eng-sre @oncall
Priya: closing thread here, updating PD and filing postmortem doc in /product/incidents. Will follow up with a short RCA tomorrow — please add anything I missed. :white_check_mark:
